slides.title: Start the connector
slides.html: Start the connector (see Install the connector): its page opens in your default browser. The first time it asks you to add your Deploy App.

slides.title: Open the MDM page
slides.html: On the same computer and in the same browser, sign in to Deploy App as an admin. Open User Management, then MDM.

slides.title: Open enrolment
slides.html: Press Open for 2 hours. Every opening makes a new challenge, which your MDM needs.

slides.title: Hand it to the connector
slides.html: Press Open in the MDM connector. It opens the connector in a new tab, with this opening's settings.

slides.title: No new tab?
slides.html: Check that the connector is running and that Deploy App is open in the same browser. Or press Copy settings and paste the line on the connector's first card.

slides.title: Add your Deploy App
slides.html: Check that the name is your Deploy App's, then press Add golden-monkey.example.fi. Any web page can open the connector, so add only the one you expect.

slides.title: What your MDM needs
slides.html: The connector now asks what your MDM needs. With Fleet, see Set Fleet up for Deploy App in MDM: Fleet.

slides.title: It sets your MDM up
slides.html: After Connect, the connector sets your MDM up, which can take a minute or two. Each step is ticked when it is done.

slides.title: Connected
slides.html: Your MDM's group for this Deploy App now has the certificate, the policy, the apps and the Deploy App icon. Press Show the phones.

slides.title: Ready for phones
slides.html: The page lists this Deploy App's phones: none yet. Leave it open and enrol the phones.

slides.title: Without the connector
slides.html: Without the connector, technical staff can set most of this up in your MDM by hand. With Fleet, see Set Fleet up without the connector in MDM: Fleet.
